verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the manuscript's 50,000-word cap, approximate 37,000-word baseline, initial available capacity, and project-wide word-budget scope.
The client establishes a flexible 2,500–3,500-word chapter-planning guideline and requires theory-focused chapters to remain concise.
The client replaces the general chapter range with a range specific to basic non-Q&A chapters and makes Q&A chapter size flexible within the overall book limit.
The contract draft's 14,000-word figure creates a material unresolved conflict with the established manuscript cap, baseline, and available allocation.
The client corrects the manuscript allocation to 13,000 words; the obsolete approximate and potentially expandable allocation keys are validly removed from the prior state.
The client's authoritative 13,000-word correction resolves the material word-budget ambiguity and returns the requirement to active status.
